notes.title: Efpiyes is out!
notes.content:
I'm thrilled to announce that Efpiyes is now available on Steam!

The biggest change since the open beta started is that now there are bots. If you want to practice by yourself, or just get a feel for the game, you've got bots. The bots cover a wide range of difficulty levels, from slow and clumsy to swift and deadly. And they're not just combat machines; they know what they're doing in all the different game modes.

It's been a fascinating journey to get here, and I hope you'll join me on the road ahead!

notes.title: Last Weekend of Efpiyes Open Beta
notes.content: The Efpiyes open beta will end on Monday, so now's the time to give it a try if you haven't already.

notes.title: Efpiyes v0.11 now has ball games!
notes.content:
Efpiyes v0.11 introduces new game modes Steal the Bacon, and Grim Piñata. There's also a link to the Discord server in game, which should make it easier to connect with other players and find games.

[h1]Steal the Bacon[/h1]

Carry the ball to earn time. Kill the guy with the ball to take it from him.

[h1]Grim Piñata[/h1]

Similar to Steal the Bacon, but more balls keep spawning as the game goes on. When you take down a player carrying several balls, he explodes in a cornucopia of balls, and the other players have to scramble to pick up as many as they can without getting killed themselves.

notes.title: Efpiyes Open Beta Starts Today!
notes.content:
I am excited to announce the Efpiyes open beta!

From now until Jan. 22nd, Efpiyes is free and open to everyone. (Just click on "Request Access" and confirm, and Efpiyes Playtest will be added to your library.) I'm hoping to get lots of feedback before the game is released. So come on down and join the mayhem. Join me on [url=https://discord.com/channels/1055224863272480828/1055224863272480830]Discord[/url] to share you thoughts.

--Khor
